definitions.short: Shur , a region of the Desert
definitions.full: H7793. Shur III. שׁוּר proper name, of a location southwest of Palestine, on east border of Egypt ; — Gen 16:7 (J; שׁ ׳דֶּרֶךְ ), 20:1 (E), towards Egypt 25:18 (J), 1Sam 15:7 , שׁ֫וּרָה 27:8 ; ׳מִדְּבַּרשֿׁ Exod 15:22 (J). — Often supposed to denote properly the 'wall' or line of fortresses, built by Egyptian kings across isthmus of Suez; but dubious: compare Dr Hast. DB SHUR .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.
Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, that is before Egypt.
David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land, who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.
